mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_contexts ( user_id, content, content_key, status, source_type, evidence_type, fact_kind, fact_label, course_id, topic_id, topic_photo_id, section_id, scope_start, scope_end, self_level, help_level, source_message_id, supersedes_context_id, confirmed_at, said_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{content}, #{contentKey}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{evidenceType}, #{factKind}, #{factLabel}, #{courseId}, #{topicId}, #{topicPhotoId}, #{sectionId}, #{scopeStart}, #{scopeEnd}, #{selfLevel}, #{helpLevel}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{supersedesContextId}, #{confirmedAt}, #{saidAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_contexts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND source_type = 'SELF_CHECK' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE') ORDER BY updated_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE user_contexts SET topic_id = #{topicId} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND topic_photo_id = #{photoId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE')
mapper.select: SELECT course_id FROM user_contexts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id IS NOT NULL AND fact_kind IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE') GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(said_at, updated_at)) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
